verdict.rationale: Restate documents a dedicated 'streaming responses' AI pattern for streaming updates from Restate services to the UI via Server-Sent Events (restate-docs-62). A companion pattern covers calling Restate agents from Next.js/React frontends (restate-docs-61), which covers the core of the story. Evidence is limited to one-line page summaries, so it is unclear whether streaming is native or needs extra plumbing. missing for 10: explicit evidence of token-level LLM streaming vs. step updates, detail on how the SSE mechanism works (native vs. extra pub/sub infrastructure), independent or hands-on corroboration.
